definitions.explanation: Used or discarded paper that is no longer needed.

examples.japanese: {紙屑|かみくず}をゴミ{箱|ばこ}に{捨|す}てた。
examples.english: I threw the wastepaper in the trash can.

examples.japanese: {机|つくえ}の{上|うえ}に{紙屑|かみくず}が{散|ち}らばっている。
examples.english: Scrap paper is scattered on the desk.

examples.japanese: {紙屑|かみくず}はリサイクルできる。

notes:
{紙屑|かみくず} means wastepaper or scrap paper that is discarded.

WORD FORMATION:
{紙|かみ} (paper) + {屑|くず} (scraps, waste)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {紙屑|かみくず}を{捨|す}てる: to throw away wastepaper
- {紙屑|かみくず}をまとめる: to gather up scrap paper
- {紙屑|かみくず}にする: to reduce to waste (figurative: to make worthless)

RELATED WORDS:
- {屑籠|くずかご}/{紙屑入|かみくずい}れ: wastepaper basket
- ゴミ: garbage, trash
- {古紙|こし}: used paper (for recycling)
- {紙|かみ}ゴミ: paper waste

OTHER 〜{屑|くず} COMPOUNDS:
- {鉄屑|てつくず}: scrap metal
- {木屑|きくず}: wood shavings
